protocol.comparison: DFlash2 B3 (4-row verify) with Q6-head select vs same-session AR (13.4 tok/s) and exact native MTP B3 (23.85 tok/s, 1.7845x AR)
protocol.note: Select-path fix: draft logits now computed through the session's amortized Q6_K t16 head (reads the 0.6 GiB quantized head once across rows) instead of the 2.54 GiB dequantized BF16 head. Select 70ms -> 22ms (logits 43ms -> 12ms). Acceptance unchanged (2.80); AR-exact all rows.

blocker: Q4_K_M lane: DFlash2 acceptance (2.80 B3) is below MTP B3 (3.85); the drafter feeds on quantized target hidden so its acceptance advantage over MTP (reference 4.80 vs 4.28 is BF16/T>0) does not materialize. B3 verify (166ms) is shared with MTP; drafter forward (~75ms) + select (22ms) vs MTP's ~5ms draft. Even with the optimized select, B3 = 0.66x AR < MTP B3 1.78x AR; zeroing the whole drafter leaves 1.26x AR < 1.78x. No operating point reaches MTP B3 on the Q4/8060S lane.
